context: Naoko reaches a major milestone in business; whole crew gathers.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 皆、よう集まってくれたな!
lines.style: Loud, brassy Kansai warmth from the belly. Opening note hits bright and unguarded. Delighted surprise with a laugh underneath. Fast, generous pacing—the kind of aunt who fills the room.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence from deep in the chest. Warm gravity—not solemn, just settling into the weight of the moment. Light emphasis on the 'milestone' idea. Eyes steady, nodding slightly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おばさん、本当におめでとう!
lines.style: Soft and genuine, no performance. Breath just slightly caught with warmth. Speaking directly to her, not to the room. Trailing off gently—the words land, then silence respects them.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お疲れさまでした、長い道のり。
lines.en: Thank you for everything. What a long road.
lines.style: Tender and quiet, almost meditation-like. Soft attack on the opening. Slow, deliberate pacing. A sense of really seeing what was traveled. Exhale at the end—relief and acknowledgment mixed.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered childlike brightness. Quick tempo, genuine awe underneath. The 'amazing' lands with real conviction—not exaggerated, just fully felt. Wide-eyed, leaning forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Nothing but gratitude from me. Really.
lines.style: Warm Kansai softness beneath the words. Humble, not self-effacing. The 'really' at the end carries quiet sincerity—a small reassurance. Steady eye-contact, genuine.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 皆の応援、おかげで、できた。
lines.en: I only made it because of all of you.
lines.style: Softer than her opening—still warm, still Naoko, but stripped down. The vulnerability underneath the loudness. Steady pacing. A moment of real tenderness from a woman who usually fills the room with noise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Elder voice, quiet pride settling in. Slow, unhurried. Each word has its own weight. Not effusive—just true. A grandfather's way of saying 'I see what you carried.'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: これからも、応援するね。
lines.en: From here on, we're cheering you on.
lines.style: Soft, steady promise. Gentle opening, no rush. Warm throughout—like sitting beside someone and meaning what you say. Clear eye-line, reliable. The kind of support that asks nothing back.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Quiet, almost whispered reverence. Tender at the center. Slow pace—savoring the moment. Soft opening attack, gentle trailing-off into reflection. The voice of someone who notices what matters.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Auntie, I love you so much!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded childhood warmth. Quick energy underneath, but the 'love' lands soft and sincere. Not performed—completely genuine. Wide-eyed, open-hearted.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: I love you all too! Every last one of you!
lines.style: Loud, brassy Kansai bloom from the chest. Generous and unselfconscious. Bright attack on 'love,' then spreading outward to fill the room. The kind of unguarded affection only an aunt who's earned the right can give.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Warm Kansai call. Light, lifting energy. The 'let's' pulls people in, inclusive. Quick tempo, the warmth of someone who loves a gathering. Ready-to-go, genuine.
